blocks.text: Grouping source IP addresses together facilitates their use in policies.
Source IP Groups provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Configure security and forwarding policies for a group of workloads in a single policy using their source IP addresses.
Add and remove source workloads from a group without requiring a new security policy.

blocks.heading: About the Source IP Groups Page

blocks.text: On the Source IP Groups page (Internet Access > Resources > IP & FQDN Groups > Source IPv4 Groups tab), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a source IP group.
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all source IP groups. For each group, you can view:
Name: The name of the Source IP group.
IP Addresses: The IP addresses included in the group.
Description: The description of the group, if available.
